messages:
celeste: Heads-up — found a subtle parity/interop issue in the Next starter + LlamaIndex sample that trips the eval harness intermittently. Repro and notes below.

celeste: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-llama-starter (branch: eval-delim). Steps: pnpm i && pnpm dev, open /eval, run the conversation test. ~1/10 runs the harness reports an extra "turn" (cost +1) even though the UI shows one model call.

rory: do we count turns by NDJSON 'event: turn_end' or by HTTP chunk count?

celeste: harness counts server-sent delimiters ("event: turn_end") emitted by runtime. In flaky runs the SDK client coalesces two adjacent events while parsing NDJSON, so the harness sees one combined token stream but the backend had emitted two turn_end delimiters; our post-processing accidentally increments the turn counter twice in some traces.

imran: hmm—so parsing semantics differ slightly across runtimes/packing. Is this only in Node dev (next dev) or seen in Dedicated?

celeste: repro on local dev and a small subset of staging lanes that use our HTTP/1 keepalive proxy. Not seen on the pure-hosted path. Looks like chunk packing + client NDJSON parser timing causes off-by-one delimiter processing.

tess: actionable: make harness resilient — instead of counting raw delimiter tokens, collapse consecutive identical delimiters within a short time window (50ms) and treat as one. Also add an assertion tolerance (0.2 calls) for flaky lanes.

rory: SDK-side fix: ensure the NDJSON parser always emits each event atomically and preserve explicit delimiter boundaries. Also add an option in the sample eval harness to prefer server-side event stamps when available (we attach X-Event-TS).

ci-bot: Issue created: RED-DEVEX-4510 "Eval harness: NDJSON delimiter coalescing causes extra turn counts in Next starter" (assignee: tess).

imran: I'll open a tiny PR to the sample to change the harness counting logic and add a repro test that simulates packed chunks. tess please add the harness tolerance and a short README note for instructors.

celeste: thanks — this was causing confusing workshop flakiness and spurious cost regressions. PRs incoming. :sparkles:
